name: std::stop_token::stop_requested
intro: Checks if the stop_token object has associated stop-state and that state has received a stop request. A default constructed stop_token has no associated stop-state, and thus has not had stop requested.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the stop_token object has associated stop-state and it received a stop request, false otherwise.
